articles.author: Scott Nover
articles.title: Trump administration is paying $1.6 million a week to keep Voice of America staff on leave - The Washington Post
articles.description: Hundreds of VOA staffers have been on paid leave since the agency sidelined them in March 2025.
articles.content: More than a year after the Trump administration attempted to dismantle Voice of America, it is paying an estimated $1.6 million a week to keep 420 of its staffers on administrative leave, according t… [+98 chars]
